_comment: Canned conversation for the MVP. **text** renders bold, [[text]] renders bold in the accent colour, {diningLeft} is filled in from the live budget.

conversation.text: I'm having sushi tonight, about $60. Which card should I use?
Use **Gold Dining**. It earns 4× on restaurants, about [[$4.80]] back on $60.
Heads up: this puts Dining at 107% of budget. Want me to move $30 from Shopping?

actions.label: Yes, move $30
actions.reply: Done. I moved **$30** from Shopping to Dining, so you now have [[{diningLeft}]] left for dining this month.

actions.label: Not now
actions.reply: No problem. I'll keep an eye on **Dining** and nudge you if it gets tight.

replies.text: Most of the overspend is **Dining out**: [[$368 of $400]] with 7 days left. Weekend delivery orders pushed it 18% above September.
Three renewals this week: **Netflix** on Monday ($22.99), **Spotify** on Wednesday ($19.99) and **iCloud+** on Friday ($9.99). Rent is due Nov 1.
You're 65% of the way to **Japan Trip**. Keeping [[$440 a month]] gets you there by Mar 2027, and round-ups would make it 5 weeks sooner.
Use **Gold Dining** for restaurants (4×), **Sapphire Travel** for flights and hotels (5×) and **Cash+ Everyday** for everything else (2%).

fallback: I can help with budgets, cards, subscriptions and savings goals. Try asking **Where did I overspend?**
